title: Factory Production Orders Paint-Line Rebooking Bulletin for Late Acknowledgments
content:
Paint-line rebooking adds business days on Factory Production Orders to the late-acknowledgment shift according to the openings priced on the exterior color change orders of the window contract the order builds:

- openings numbering at least half of the units on the order add **2 business days**;
- at least one opening but fewer than half adds **1 business day**;
- no such opening adds nothing.

These days are added to the late-acknowledgment shift as whole business days before the late-acknowledgment revised ship date is counted.

## Where the openings are found

The openings are read from the Window Replacement Contracts records of the contract the order builds: every change order on that contract whose kind is exterior color, taking the openings each such line prices, summed over all of them. The comparison is with the units on the factory order.

## Threshold on both sides (hypothetical orders)

| Units on the order | Exterior color openings priced | Half of the units | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 5 | 5 | 2 |
| 10 | 4 | 5 | 1 |
| 9 | 5 | 4.5 | 2 |
| 9 | 4 | 4.5 | 1 |
| 10 | 1 | 5 | 1 |
| 10 | 0 | 5 | none |

Exactly half of the units counts as at least half.

## Questions answered

- *Two exterior color change orders of 3 openings each on a 12-unit order?* The openings are summed to 6, which is half of 12: 2 business days.
- *A change order of another kind, such as a hardware finish?* It prices no exterior color opening and does not count here.
